description: Austrian "Bezeichnung des sachlichen Bereiches" prefixes that replace the authority code (KDV 1967 § 26 Abs. 4): BD = Bundesbusdienst omnibuses of the ÖBB and the former Post- und Telegraphenverwaltung (lit. f), BH = Heeresfahrzeuge (lit. g), BP = Bundespolizei (lit. a), FV = Finanzverwaltung (lit. c), JW = Justizwache (lit. h), PT = Post (lit. e). Excluded: lit. i (FW, fire brigade) has a different Vormerkzeichen form and lives in its own scheme, and lit. b and lit. d were repealed by BGBl. II Nr. 275/2007 and BGBl. II Nr. 376/2002. BD collides with the diplomatic prefix B+D of § 26 Abs. 5, a genuine textual ambiguity.
